headline: A 1-for-5 night
record_line: Yesterday: 1-4 on the top plays · Season: 10-55

entries.headline: Kyle Schwarber stayed in the yard
entries.story: Kyle Schwarber went 2-for-5 with 1 RBI against Miles Mikolas and the Washington Nationals. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 2 times.

entries.headline: Eugenio Suárez came close
entries.story: Eugenio Suárez went 1-for-2 with 2 BB and 1 RBI against Mason Barnett and the Athletics. Closest call was a double in the 7th: "Eugenio Suárez doubles (13) on a fly ball to center fielder Henry Bolte." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Pete Alonso stayed in the yard
entries.story: Pete Alonso went 1-for-3 with 1 BB against Ryan Johnson and the Los Angeles Angels. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Mike Trout stayed in the yard
entries.story: Mike Trout went 0-for-4 with 1 BB against Brandon Young and the Baltimore Orioles. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 2 times.

entries.headline: Sal Stewart connected at +353
entries.story: Sal Stewart cashed. Facing Mason Barnett, he went deep in the 4th in his 2nd at bat. The call: "Sal Stewart homers (25) on a fly ball to center field." Final line: 2-for-4.
